economic conditions have created opportunities to negotiate lower rental rates.
+GPM is expected to improve, supported by the company’s ongoing efforts to restructure 
and optimize its cost structure.
+Effective inventory management of the Sabina brand has resulted in a reduction of loans 
by THB 200 million, strengthening the company’s overall financial position. Notably, 
inventory levels declined while inventory turnover continued to improve.
+Sabina’s consistent recognition through ESG awards from various institutions in recent 
years has reinforced confidence among OEM clients, particularly in the UK&EU. This has 
led to forward bookings of the company’s production capacity, aligning well with the 
strategy to limit Sabina product output during an economic downturn.What are we in Q3 2025 Financial Highlight Business Update

+The upcoming enforcement of a 7% value -added tax (VAT) on imported goods 
priced below THB 1,500, starting early next year, is expected to ease the 
intensity of competition in the online market.
+Government stimulus measures planned for the end of the year are expected 
to reinvigorate overall economic activity.
+The OEM segment has benefited from Trump tariff policies, resulting in 
increased inquiries from new clients.
+Outsourcing operations have also benefited from the U.S. –China tariff 
negotiations. As it became more difficult for China to export to the U.S., 
Chinese suppliers shifted their focus to Asia, treating it as a key market.
